verdict.rationale: The official BugSnag CLI is documented as uploading files to improve the stacktraces in your errors (docs-45, probe-4), and the product has iOS and Android SDKs. So a first-party symbol-upload path exists, but the evidence never names which file types it accepts. JavaScript source-map support (docs-11) is a different symbolication story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dSYM upload for iOS, ProGuard/R8 mapping upload for Android, native (NDK/ELF) debug symbol upload, evidence that crashes resolve to function names and line numbers, and hands-on corroboration.
